subject: planner: Correct cardinality estimate for subset index match (#50574)
summary: Reviewed the planner-only change in `pkg/planner/cardinality/row_count_index.go` (the `expBackoffEstimation` selectivity combiner used by stats-v2 index range row-count estimation). The new NDV-based floor plus subset-vs-full differentiation is conservative (it can only increase estimated selectivity / rowcount vs the previous formula) and is additionally capped by histogram-derived upper limits at the call site; no Blocker/High issues found in correctness, semantics, data consistency, or runtime stability.
